title: 4.11 Everyday Verbs
unit_outcome: Talk about your home, where things are, your morning, what you do at home, the days, the time and the months in Spanish.
goal: Use everyday verbs: veo, encuentro, uso, hago, vengo, le doy.
grammar_function: Present tense + object; personal a for people and animals.
speaking_outcome: Use everyday verbs: veo, encuentro, uso, hago, vengo, le doy.
